blocks.title: CAT Day 3 — Percentages + Linear Arrangements
blocks.details: Mission: Lock down base-change formulas (x% increase followed by y% decrease) and linear seating deductions. Quant: Percentages LOD 1 & LOD 2: 25 questions covering Net Price change, A is x% more than B, and income-expenditure splits. DILR: Linear Arrangements 1 (Single Row, all facing North). Solve 2 sets from Rodha DILR Playlist. Focus on definite vs conditional clues.
